title: Melodic Ballad Lead Practice Bed
purpose: Provide an original spacious ballad progression for sustained lead phrasing, bends, vibrato, dynamics, call-and-response, and deliberate silence.
feel: slow straight ballad with long phrase windows and explicit guitar space

tracks.name: Drums
tracks.instrument_intent: restrained kit maintaining pulse without fills that crowd sustained lead phrases

tracks.name: Bass
tracks.instrument_intent: round supportive bass; keep movement predictable so lead phrasing remains the focus

tracks.name: Keys
tracks.instrument_intent: soft electric-piano whole-bar voicings with low density and clear upper-register space for guitar

provenance.notes: Original common-practice ballad harmony designed for lead phrasing and intentional space.
